tier_reason: First-party table (Milvus docs + identical table in the project README) comparing Woodpecker vs Kafka and Pulsar in a single-node/single-client/single-stream write test; no hardware/CPU model, Kafka/Pulsar configs or payload sizes stated, and the repo's tests/benchmark/ suite only exercises Woodpecker itself (no Kafka/Pulsar harness), so C.

corrections.license: Apache-2.0 (server/ directory dual-licensed AGPL-3.0-only OR SSPL-1.0)
corrections.caveats: First-party benchmark from the Milvus/Zilliz docs and project README; no CPU/hardware model stated ("our test machine"); Kafka/Pulsar tuning and dataset are undocumented; no public Kafka/Pulsar comparison harness (tests/benchmark/ covers Woodpecker only); single-node/single-stream test, not a distributed cluster comparison. Not uniformly faster: MinIO mode is slower than Kafka (71 MB/s vs 129.96 MB/s) and S3/MinIO modes have higher latency (166 ms / 184 ms vs Kafka 58 ms, Pulsar 35 ms). License is split: Apache-2.0 except server/ which is AGPL-3.0-only OR SSPL-1.0 (GitHub reports NOASSERTION).
